首页/CSS/第 271 题
QA ★★☆☆☆ 简单 CSS

使用原生js实现以下效果：点击容器内的图标，图标边框变成border:1px solid red，点击空白处重置

参考答案

```js

const box = document.getElementById('box');

function isIcon(target) {<br> return target.className.includes('icon');<br>}

box.onclick = function(e) {<br> e.stopPropagation();<br> const target = e.target;<br> if (isIcon(target)) {<br> target.style.border = '1px solid red';<br> }<br>}

const doc = document;

doc.onclick = function(e) {<br> const children = box.children;<br> for(let i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {<br> if (isIcon(children[i])) {<br> children[i].style.border = 'none';<br> }<br> }<br>}
